observations.claim_summary: Dreisbach Wholesale Florists describes itself as serving professional florists and businesses with wholesale flowers, greenery and supplies across six branch locations; Louisville is the corporate office.
observations.source_title: Dreisbach Wholesale Florists — Employment / branch list

observations.claim_summary: Growjo estimates $7.5M annual revenue and 46 employees for Dreisbach Wholesale Florist. The profile does not expose source methodology or establish whether its revenue covers all six branches.

external_estimates.notes: Only one non-methodological public revenue estimate was found. Its scope conflicts with the official six-branch footprint. It is evidence to validate, not a defensible GMV range.
No external COGS or gross-margin source was found. A generic wholesale ratio would be an internal model and must be labeled and calibrated separately.
